boxes.title: Géométrie élémentaire schématique
boxes.seen: Seen on 23 October: 549 leaves of text in eighteen sections, 19 August – 1 October 1992, plus 32 leaves of « Gribouillis ». Read on 29 October: pochette 2 (§ 15 numbered and dated, e.g. Proposition 15.1.17, f. 168v; § 16 projective involutions, PsInv(M), Inv_*(M) → Invpr(M), f. 297v; no link with Trialité) and pochette 4 (quadratic algebras and 2 × 2 matrices, exterior products; nothing on P¹ ∖ {0,1,∞}, M_{0,4} or Galois; references to § 18.7–18.11, among them « diviseurs aux relations anharmoniques »). Pochette 3: on f. 378 he presents the text as a chapter of the EGA (paraphrase; a request to quote is with the BnF); the volume stops in § 18.8 « Dualités » (f. 517v), with no § 18.9. Pochette 1, the table: no chapter number and no reference to EGA or SGA; § 18 is titled « Groupes quadratiques et relations anharmoniques ». Pochette 4 again: a sheet « anharmonicité et dualité » with the matrix algebra End(O_S ⊕ Λ), calculations only, no draft of § 18.9.
boxes.question: Does the 1992 volume take up the EGA V drafts kept at the IHÉS (« Formes lisses, et formes quadratiques lisses », c. 1969, and « Résultant et discriminant »), or start afresh?

Smooth quadratic forms of rank n ↔ torsors under O(n); reduction to μ₂ = O(n)/SO(n)
Characteristic 2 treated apart: x² + yz an ordinary singularity, « smooth » versus « non-degenerate »
The resultant, or the discriminant of a form of degree n > 2
The Pfaffian (« discriminant = square of the Pfaffian » in even rank, characteristic 2)
A reference to EGA IV, EGA V, SGA 3 (SGAD XXIV) or to a « plan »

boxes.title: Géographie combinatoire, Trialité, and the physics notes of 1996–97
boxes.seen: Seen on 23 October: finite « forestiers » sets whose elements play the part of « secteurs géographiques ». Read on 29 October: pochette 2 (physics notes, « Erreurs et aberrations » against Maxwell and the Poynting vector); pochette 1, the « géographie combinatoire » (nested sectors indexed by a forest, X(i) the disjoint union of the X(z) over minimal vertices, a cube crossed by one ordered path) and the table of section D. Trialité skimmed: numbered and dated statements on quadratic modules and their orientations (a submodule with ε ↔ a set with a fixed-point-free involution), about 170 words a page.
boxes.question: Pochette 1: does the 1996 geography take up the Géométrie des formes of 1986 (156: pieces and their incidences, a « contrée »), or the maps of 1982 (144, 147)? Pochette 2: what mathematics is in the physics notes?

items.text: The 1986 vocabulary: lieux, strates, multistrates, figures, « contrées », « magasin », « atelier »
The « représentations géographiques » of 146 (p. 127): graphs whose vertices carry a genus, as on the boundary of M_g,ν
The three relations of 1986: being a face of, being inside, being disjoint from
No points: sectors are the primitive data, as the lieux were in 1986
The « forêts »: trees, networks or ordered sets, like the segments and networks of 156-1 to 156-3
The maps of 1982: flags, the cartographic group (τ₀, τ₁, τ₂), dessins, coverings
A reference to Analysis situs, to « GF », to 1986, to tame topology or to the Esquisse
An induction on dimension (the programme of 156-1: a geometry of forms in dimension n)
